subject: OBJECT paragraph
notes: SR1 "Interface-name-1 shall be the name of an interface specified in the REPOSITORY paragraph of the containing class definition" (cite.py --check 11.8.3 OK). CaptureImplements resolves each name through the §8.4.6.4 funnel with Want.Interface at the class's scope (cite.py --check 8.4.6.4 OK); a REPOSITORY in the OBJECT paragraph itself is forbidden by §12.3.3 SR3 so the class scope is the only one.
